characterList.description: A middle-aged man with short brown hair and a beard, wearing camouflage clothing, a black t-shirt, a baseball cap, and hiking boots.
characterList.name: Pondguru

content_metadata.description: Pondguru ventures into the wild to cook a steak using a portable stove, showcasing outdoor equipment and proposing a collaborative video series.

qAndA.answer: He uses a telescopic fire blower. (Timestamp 1:02)
qAndA.question: What tool does Pondguru use to make the fire in the stove grow?

qAndA.answer: The wood he collected is wet due to recent rain. (Timestamp 1:43)
qAndA.question: Why is Pondguru having difficulty getting the fire going?

qAndA.answer: He uses Sucklebusters Peach Barbecue Sauce. (Timestamp 2:47)
qAndA.question: What brand of BBQ sauce does Pondguru use on the steak?

qAndA.answer: He wants to bring together content creators with different areas of expertise in outdoor activities to create educational and helpful videos for viewers. (Timestamp 4:20 - 4:35)
qAndA.question: What is the main reason Pondguru is proposing a collaborative video series?

qAndA.answer: He believes it gets infused with a smoky flavor that makes it taste better than when cooked indoors. (Timestamp 4:18)
qAndA.question: How does cooking the steak on a fire outdoors impact its flavor, according to Pondguru?

youtube_description:
The first half of this video is cooking a steak in the woods using a Lixada folding wood stove: http://geni.us/cWgjSD and V3 pocket bellow tube: http://geni.us/xVsl4z (US) / http://geni.us/LjZOAy (UK & Europe).
Excellent video showing how to make a DIY bellow from Kulcraven Bushcraft: https://goo.gl/jLvmV2
Previous video using the peach BBQ sauce: https://goo.gl/qFZq21
This was one of the best steaks I have ever eaten....

The second half of the video is a repeat of the idea I have for a community Youtube project which will produce monthly outdoor videos in a magazine format.
If you are interested in being a part of the project please contact me any time. Richard: pondguru@btinternet.com / 07772848730

If you've enjoyed this video please check out the playlists on my channel for hundreds more  - on a variety of subjects.
Feel free to share or link any of my videos on facebook, twitter, forums etc. for the benefit of anyone you think may also enjoy watching.
See you next time.
Pondguru
